response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS a FROM counts) SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(c.cnt - aa.a) AS avg_excess_above_average FROM counts c CROSS JOIN avg_all aa WHERE c.cnt > aa.a
